questions.question: Directions: Study the following information carefully answer the given questions. A + B means A is the daughter of B. A & B means A is the son of B. A % B means A is the husband of B. A @ B means A is the mother of B. Which of the following expressions represents ‘F’ is the father in law of ‘I’?
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Study the following information carefully answer the given questions.

A + B means A is the daughter of B.

A & B means A is the son of B.

A % B means A is the husband of B.

A @ B means A is the mother of B.

Which of the following expressions represents ‘F’ is the father in law of ‘I’?
questions.solution:
In F % G @ H % I, means F is the husband of G. G is the mother of H. H is the husband of I.

Hence, F is the father-in-law of I.

questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
questions.questionHtml: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
questions.solution:
Here, we need to find the pattern and get the missing number.

The logic here is: (1st number × 3) + (1st number ÷ 3) = 2nd number.

1) 93 \(\times\) 3 + 31 = 310,

2) 54 \(\times\) 3 + 18 = 180

3) 48 \(\times\) 3 + 16 = 160 \(\ne\) 165

4) 33 \(\times\) 3 + 11 = 110

Thus, the pattern is: Each 1st is multiplied by 3 and then 2nd term first two digits are added to the answer to get the final answer.

Hence, the correct option is 48 - 165

Alternate MethodLogic: (1st number ÷ 3) × 10 = 2nd number.

1) (93 ÷ 3) × 10 → 31 × 10 = 310,

2) (54 ÷ 3) × 10 → 18 × 10 = 180,

3) (48 ÷ 3) × 10 → 16 × 10 = 160 ≠ 165

4) (33 ÷ 3) × 10 → 11 × 10 = 110.

questions.question: If ‘A’ denotes ‘+’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘–’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation? 21 A 34 C 6 B (72 D 9) A 13 B 1 + (56 D 4) = ?
questions.questionHtml:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘+’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘–’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

21 A 34 C 6 B (72 D 9) A 13 B 1 + (56 D 4) = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

Here, we have a equation as

21 A 34 C 6 B (72 D 9) A 13 B 1 + (56 D 4)

Let us decode the given sign:

Alphabet Sign
A +
B × 
C -
D ÷ 

= 21 + 34 - 6 × (72 ÷ 9) + 13 × 1 + (56 ÷ 4)

Applying BODMAS rule, we will get,

= 21 + 34 - 6 × 8 + 13 × 1 + 14

= 21 + 34 - 48 + 13 + 14

= 82 - 48

= 34

Hence, the correct answer is "34".

questions.question: Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69
questions.solution:
We apply the options to the given equation & solve it by using BODMAS rule:

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 1) 56 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 56 + 21 ÷ 7 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 3 × 9 = 69

⇒ 98 − 56 + 27 = 69

⇒ 125 - 56 = 69

⇒ 69 = 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 2) 56 and 21, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 56 ÷ 7 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 8 × 21 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 168 = 69

⇒ 266 - 9 = 69

⇒ 257 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 3) 98 and 9, + and ×

After Interchanging:

⇒ 9 − 98 + 21 ÷ 7 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 3 × 56 = 69

⇒ 9 − 98 + 168 = 69

⇒ 177 - 98 = 69

⇒ 79 ≠ 69

Given Equation: 98 − 9 × 21 ÷ 7 + 56 = 69

Option 4) 21 and 7, + and −

After Interchanging:

⇒ 98 − 9 + 7 ÷ 21 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 0.33 × 56 = 69

⇒ 98 − 9 + 18.66 = 69

⇒ 116.66 - 9 = 69

⇒ 107.66 ≠ 69

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Consider the following number sequence: 4 5 3 6 9 1 7 2 5 8 1 5 3 8 4 3 2 1 6 6 4 1 If all the odd numbers are eliminated from the sequence, which number is 4 th to the left of the 9 th number from extreme left end?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following number sequence:

4 5 3 6 9 1 7 2 5 8 1 5 3 8 4 3 2 1 6 6 4 1

If all the odd numbers are eliminated from the sequence, which number is 4th to the left of the 9th number from extreme left end?
questions.solution:
Key Points

Odd numbers are not divisible by 2.

Given number sequence without odd numbers:

Left end 4 6 2 8 8 4 2 6 6 4 Right end

9th number from extreme left end = 6

4th to the left of 6 = 8

Hence, “8” is the correct answer.
